text: かいぬしの　じまん　ばなしには　しずかに　みみを　かたむけよう！

structure.jp: かいぬしの　じまん　ばなしには
みみを　かたむけよう！

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The よう ending means 'let's do it', and on a sign or rule it works as a friendly instruction. みみを　かたむけよう = 'let's listen closely'.

patterns.name: 〜に (adverb)
patterns.explanation: に after a describing word like しずか turns it into the way something is done. しずかに = 'quietly'.
